name: Palais de Justice historique
description: A 19th-century courthouse with 24 columns facing the Saône, where the Gestapo chief Klaus Barbie was tried in 1987.
wikipedia: Palais de justice historique de Lyon

name: Jean Moulin Memorial
description: The house in Caluire where the Gestapo arrested Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, in 1943. It is now a memorial.

name: Resistance and Deportation History Center
description: A museum of the Resistance and the deportations, in a building the Gestapo used as its Lyon headquarters during the war.
wikipedia: Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation

name: Institut Lumière
description: The Lumière family villa and the factory hall where the brothers filmed workers leaving in 1895, now a museum of early cinema.

name: La Longue Traboule
description: A traboule, a covered passage through the courtyards of old houses, in Vieux Lyon, the city’s Renaissance quarter.

name: Roman theaters of Fourvière
description: Two Roman theaters on Fourvière hill, from when Lyon was Lugdunum, a capital of Roman Gaul, beside a museum of the Roman city.
